title: A Calypso Caramba
summary: A man is poisoned while Neville is at the same bar.
method: The man put the narcotic into the bottle that he and the victim drank out of. He ordered akras and tap water and put salt in the water to induce vomiting. He later poured out the poisoned rum and put a different label on it and switched glasses with Neville.
motive: The killer found out the victim forced his wife to give up her daughter years ago, which affected her enough that she stopped singing. The killer treated her like a daughter and thought she would not be happy if this man was still around.
killer: A fan of the band, someone who writes the zines
